{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]

# Identify refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']

# Now, filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
# The question asks: Among NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH, what fraction converted?
# So: channel == 'paid_search' AND customer_segment == 'new'
filtered = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check how many such rows exist
print("Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH:", len(filtered))

# Now compute conversion rate: fraction of these who converted (converted == 1)
converted_count = filtered['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(filtered)
conversion_rate = converted_count / total_count

print(f"Converted: {converted_count}, Total: {total_count}, Rate: {conversion_rate:.4f}")

# Also check if any of these filtered rows are QA orders or refunded
qa_in_filtered = filtered[filtered['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
refunded_in_filtered = filtered[filtered['status'] == 'refunded']

print(f"QA orders in filtered group: {len(qa_in_filtered)}")
print(f"Refunded orders in filtered group: {len(refunded_in_filtered)}")"}
